investApply.confirmBeforeApplyTitle: Important Notice Before Applying to Invest
investApply.confirmBeforeApplyBody:
This product invests in real estate and related assets, and part or all of your invested principal may be lost; investment returns are not guaranteed.
Please be sure to check the following before investing.
* Carefully consider your investment purpose and investment period.
* Make sure the investment amount does not strain your financial situation.
* Do not use funds needed for living expenses, emergency funds, loan repayments, etc. for investment.
* Depending on the real estate market and the status of this investment product, returns may be lower than expected or losses may occur.
* Recovering or selling your investment may take a certain amount of time, and it may not be converted to cash immediately when you want.
* The investment return rate and expected dividends do not represent a guaranteed return.
* Before investing, please thoroughly review the product's investment structure, underlying property, expected returns, risk factors, fees, and other related information.
Investments are made based on your own judgment and responsibility.
Please proceed with your investment application only after fully understanding and carefully considering the above.
